budget_items.what_was_recorded: Board considered recommendation to write off uncollectable ambulance receivables and forward remaining amounts to collection agency
budget_items.quote: the board considered a recommendation to write off $107,232.09 in uncollectable bills, representing charges that for various reasons have little to no prospect of being collected. simultaneously, the recommendation called for $65,044.85 to be forwarded to coastal's collection agency.

budget_items.topic: Flat Hill Road Bridge project bids
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Nine bids received for bridge project; lowest bid rejected for missing bond requirement; next lowest bid noted against available funding
budget_items.quote: bids were opened on may 14th for the flat hill road bridge project, with nine bids received ranging from $807,530 to $1,417,869.50. the apparent low bid of $807,530 was rejected for failure to include the required bid bond. the next lowest bid was $1,065,352. total available project funding is $1,378,500

budget_items.topic: Lunenburg Adult Activity Center and Teen Center flooring projects
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Six bids received for flooring projects within capital budget showing favorable pricing pending low bidder diligence
budget_items.quote: bids for the lunenburg adult activity center and teen center flooring projects were opened on may 6th, with six bids ranging from $74,424 to $119,000 against a $76,000 capital budget

budget_items.topic: Pavement condition assessment and management plan
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town engaged Tighe & Bond for pavement assessment funded through Chapter 90 funds with expected completion in approximately one year
budget_items.quote: the town engaged engineering firm tighe & bond for a pavement condition assessment and multi-year pavement management plan at a cost of $34,500, funded through chapter 90 funds

budget_items.topic: MassDOT Community Culvert Program award for Easter Brook design
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town received grant award from MassDOT for design work on culvert over Easter Brook on Goodrich Street, critical east-west corridor
budget_items.quote: the town received a $150,000 award from the massdot community culvert program for design work on the culvert over easter brook on goodrich street
the board signed an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $126,087.73
